Which statement about water is correct?
When water is added to solid anhydrous cobalt(II) chloride, the solid turns blue.
A
B
Water containing dissolved sodium chloride boils at a temperature greater than 100°C.
C
All dissolved metal ions found in natural sources of water are beneficial to life.
D
Soluble impurities are removed during the sedimentation stage in the treatment of drinking
water.
